standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base (this file) → register profile → family profile → record variant → scene override

params.damping_note: use engine defaults for damping/recovery/circulation unless the scene's content requires otherwise

scene_rhythm.note: reading pace: a scene holds long enough to be read; transitions complete without hurry

entities.note: one governing formation per scene where the record is one relation; more only when the record's own structure carries them

register_differentiations.note: M-branch colour/material policy: presentation policy, kept distinct from source-backed colour correspondence
register_differentiations.essay_rooms: warm paper, ink material — the reading surface
register_differentiations.episteme: print material or cooler paper — instituted knowledge, the lattice
register_differentiations.matheme: dark ground, whiteOnBlack inkMode — paśyantī, the visionary operative logic
register_differentiations.mytheme: round material, richer palette — madhyamā, lived images
register_differentiations.symbolon: deepest field (near-black paper or dark ground) — parā, the holding whole

rules: quiet records stay quiet — no ornament without argumentative job
repeated families reuse their family profile; variation is explicit and recorded
forms arise from content; provenance recorded for anything external
a repeated colour association never becomes a claimed source relation
